description:
In this video I'll show you how to improve your articulation by practicing the habit of thinking better.

FREE Frameworks Training ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/htbdws-frameworks

PRE-ORDER MY NEW BOOK ➡ https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect

=== Timestamps ===
0:00- Intro
0:47 - You don't have a speaking problem
2:46 - Framework 1
6:57 - Framework 2
10:09 - Framework 3

If you've ever been in these situations where you struggle to articulate your thoughts clearly so that you come across well-spoken, then you need to learn these powerful frameworks. Not only will they help you turn your thoughts into words faster, they'll help you think about your responses before you actually speak. This is the secret to the most influential communicators. 

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
